lead.headline: With Gonzaga gone, Saint Mary's and Santa Clara are the ones to catch
lead.deck: Saint Mary's rates 28th nationally in our model and Santa Clara 57th. Nobody else in the league is inside the top 100.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers the West Coast Conference, ten schools from Seattle to San Diego plus Stockton and Denver, which is new to the league this season. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
Saint Mary's is the early leader in our ratings at 28th nationally. The Gaels are 3-1, and the loss was 96-95 in overtime to Nevada on a neutral floor.
Santa Clara is 4-0 and rates 57th. The Broncos won their first road game, 76-71 at North Texas, as 1.5-point favorites.
San Francisco is also unbeaten at 3-0, though it rates 140th. Pacific (106th) has the league's best road result, a 63-52 win at Bradley as a short underdog.

The bottom half is tight and has lost some close ones. Loyola Marymount lost 96-95 to Queens, Seattle U lost 74-73 at Hawai'i, and Portland lost 94-88 in double overtime to East Texas A&M on Saturday.

column.label: By the Numbers
column.title: Three numbers from the first two weeks
body: **25.5.** The points Denver was getting at Wisconsin. The Pioneers lost by seven.
**3.** One-point losses in the league already: Saint Mary's, Loyola Marymount and Seattle U.
**2.** WCC teams in our national top 100, Saint Mary's and Santa Clara.

notes.headline: Denver's start
notes.body: The Pioneers are 0-2 in their first WCC season, with road losses at Wisconsin and UC Riverside.

notes.headline: Portland's scoring
notes.body: The Pilots scored 133 and 130 against non-D-I opponents and won 73-66 at Hawai'i as 7.5-point underdogs.

notes.headline: San Diego's overtime
notes.body: The Toreros beat Tarleton State 96-90 in overtime and lost by eight at Colorado as 12.5-point underdogs.

notes.headline: Next year
notes.body: UC San Diego and UC Santa Barbara join the WCC in 2027-28. Until then they stay in our Big West edition.
